ImageDescription.value:
Name: Arbel Valley and Mount Arbel - View from Karni Hit
Description: Arbel was a Jewish settlement that existed from the late Hellenistic period in the Land of Israel and reached its peak in the Roman and Byzantine periods during the Mishnah and Talmud. The settlement was located in the Arbel Valley, in the area where the Arbel settlement is located today. Several remains remain from the ancient settlement, the main one being the remains of the synagogue located north of the settlement and which is part of the Arbel National Park. (Wikipedia)
